query: on 16 January 1995 "First Knight" was being filmed at a studio located how far from Windsor ?

pipeline_result.response: Pinewood Studios is approximately 20 miles west of central London, which means it is about 34.87 miles (or 55 kilometers) away from Buckingham Palace.
retrieved_context: Pinewood Studios: Pinewood Studios is a British film and television studio located approximately 20 mi west of central London, and 7 miles from Windsor.

Filming of James Bond in the 1990s: Principal photography for the film began on 16 January 1995 and continued until 6 June.  The producers were unable to film at Pinewood Studios, the usual location for Bond films, because it had been reserved for "First Knight".  Instead, an old Rolls-Royce factory at the Leavesden Aerodrome in Hertfordshire was converted into a new studio.  The producers later said Pinewood would have been too small.

Buckingham Palace: Buckingham Palace ( ) is the London residence and administrative headquarters of the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom.  Located in the City of Westminster, the palace is often at the centre of state occasions and royal hospitality.  It has been a focal point for the British people at times of national rejoicing and mourning.
